Validation passed with no findings, including the plugin/card cross-check on 66 Q² points.

**Files produced**

- `plugin.py` sets the contact vector coefficients on down quarks: a real μμ entry of −0.05 and a complex eτ entry of 0.02 + 0.03i built from separate real and imaginary parameters. The τe partner is filled as the conjugate. All three parameters are listed as couplings so the Standard Model limit check works.
- `card.json` expresses the same interaction as one `contacts` entry on fermion `d`, with the complex entry written as `[0.02, 0.03]`.
- `notes.md` records the derivation: contact form because epsilons were given, no normalization conversion needed, Hermiticity of the eτ/τe pair, constructive interference of the μμ entry with the Standard Model charge, and incoherent contribution of the flavor-changing entry to the ν_e and ν_τ rates.

The described point is preserved exactly in both representations. No questions.json was written since the description was complete.
